name: Nakajou Atara
source:
A 3rd year student at Kirigaoka Gakuin High School who suddenly transferred to the school. Atara is aloof and elusive, he appears in front of [url=/c57817]Taiki[/url] leaving behind mysterious words. 

[Translated from the [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monochrome_(%E3%82%B2%E3%83%BC%E3%83%A0)]Japanese Wikipedia[/url].]
